Class Vector

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.geometry.Point
edu.cnu.mdi.geometry.Vector
public class Vector extends Point
A mutable three-dimensional Cartesian vector.

This class extends Point so that existing MDI code can use the same public x, y, and z fields for points and vectors. The distinction is semantic: a Point represents a location, while a Vector represents a displacement or direction.

Author:
heddle

    • cross

      public static void cross(Vector a, Vector b, Vector c)
      Computes the cross product a x b and stores it in an existing vector.

      All three result components are computed into temporaries before any are written, so the output vector may safely be the same object as either input.

      Parameters:
      a - the first vector
      b - the second vector
      c - upon return, contains a x b
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if any argument is null

    • unitVector

      public Vector unitVector()

      Returns:
      a new unit vector, or null if this vector is too close to zero to normalize
